registeredBeforeOutcomes: No historical outcome, CLI report or archive produced by PR #226 had been read when this file was committed. Every constant below is fixed; changing any of them requires a new model ID.

target.quantity: NWS CLI daily maximum temperature, whole degrees F
target.climateDay: local standard time, UTC-5 all year: [D 05:00Z, D+1 05:00Z)
target.historicalOutcomeProvenance: IEM_AFOS_CLI_ARCHIVE: the first CLINYC product issued at or after D+1 05:00Z that reports day D; observedAvailableAt is that product's issuance time. Distinct from the live collector's NWS_CLI_PRELIMINARY_CENTRAL_PARK, and never admitted into nws-empirical-error-pmf-v1 training.
target.settlementCaveat: Kalshi settles on the first official non-preliminary report (The Weather Company, then NWS). A CLI-based backtest is forecast accuracy, not settlement or profitability.

NWS.source: official NWS hourly grid, max of 24 hourly temperatures in the climate day
NWS.history: none admitted (NDFD archive unvalidated); forward only via the existing live collector

NBM.source: National Blend of Models NBS text bulletin TXN (max) with XND standard deviation

HRRR.source: HRRR 2 m temperature, max over the climate-day hours covered by a 48 h cycle (00/06/12/18Z)
HRRR.window: climate day, truncated to the cycle's 48 h
HRRR.history: none admitted until a validated grid-point extraction exists

members.selection: For each member and anchor: the latest cycle with availableAt <= anchor, at most 30 h old, whose bulletin contains the max element valid for day D. Otherwise the member is missing for that day.

anchors.DAY_AHEAD: D-1 14:00Z (9 AM EST the day before)
anchors.SAME_DAY: D 11:00Z (6 AM EST the same day)
anchors.rule: Each anchor is a separate forecast horizon with its own trailing training set. Horizon = hours from the anchor to D 05:00Z (forecastLeadHours).

training.admission: a training day counts only if its outcome's observedAvailableAt < the anchor of the day being forecast, and it has the same anchor; the 30 most recent such days form the window
training.stationSpecific: every quantity below is fitted per station and per anchor; stations never share parameters

model.biasCorrection: per member: b_i = mean(observed - f_i) over the window days where member i was present (seasonal bias is tracked by the 30-day trailing window); corrected g_i = f_i + b_i
model.weights: w_i = 0.5 * (1/m) + 0.5 * (1/MSE_i) / sum_j(1/MSE_j), MSE_i of g_i over the window; m = members present today; renormalised over present members
model.spread: s2 = sum_i w_i (g_i - mu)^2 + (XND^2 if NBM present else 0)
model.variance: sigma^2 = a + b * s2, (a, b) chosen by minimum CRPS over the window on the grid a in {1,2,...,36} F^2, b in {0,0.25,...,2}; ties to smaller a then smaller b; sigma floor 1.0 F
model.discretisation: P(high = k) = Phi((k+0.5-mu)/sigma) - Phi((k-0.5-mu)/sigma) on [round(mu)-25, round(mu)+25], edge cells hold the open tails; integer ppm, at least 1 ppm per cell, summing to exactly 1,000,000 (same rule as nws-empirical-error-pmf-v1)
model.contracts: contract and event probabilities come from the existing contract-math strike ranges (strikeIntegerRange) and the same tail-cell refusal rule

baselines.MEMBER_RAW: each member alone, uncorrected, Gaussian with sigma = its window RMSE (floor 1.0)
baselines.MEMBER_CORRECTED: each member alone, bias-corrected as above, sigma = window RMSE of g_i (floor 1.0)
baselines.NBM_NATIVE: N(TXN, max(XND, 1.0)), no correction: the blend's own published uncertainty
baselines.CLIMATOLOGY: N(mean, sd) of the window's observed highs (floor 1.0)

evaluation.walkForward: every day with >= 30 admitted window days and >= 1 member present is forecast from the window only; nothing is refit on later days
evaluation.split: scored days in date order: the first floor(n/2) are BACKTEST, the rest are HOLDOUT. The best single corrected member is chosen on BACKTEST only (lowest mean CRPS) and then compared on HOLDOUT

metrics.primary: CRPS of the integer pmf (ranked probability score over whole degrees)
secondary: MAE of the point forecast round(mu)
log loss of the observed whole degree

evaluation.uncertainty: moving-block bootstrap of the paired daily CRPS difference, block 7 days, 2000 replicates, seed 20261126

decisionRule.PROMISING: on HOLDOUT, per anchor: holdout days >= 50; combined mean CRPS below the BACKTEST-chosen best corrected member, below NBM_NATIVE and below CLIMATOLOGY; the bootstrap 95% upper bound of (combined - best member) CRPS < 0; 80% coverage within [0.70, 0.90]
decisionRule.REJECTED: holdout days >= 50 and the bootstrap 95% lower bound of (combined - best member) CRPS > 0
decisionRule.NO_CLEAR_EFFECT: anything else, including fewer than 50 holdout days
decisionRule.evidenceType: retrospective: the learning engine caps it at PROMISING; READY_FOR_REVIEW needs forward frozen evidence
decisionRule.notProfitability: No Kalshi price, quote, fee or fill is used. Nothing here measures trading edge or profitability.

requires: a forward capture of NBM and GFS MOS bulletins frozen before each anchor (not built here; collection belongs to the existing collector owner)
>= 50 forward holdout days meeting the decision rule (existing review gate)
owner approval; exchange access stays disabled until the owner enables it
